title: Inference for stochastic differential equations driven by weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion using neural networks and the Euler approximation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00793v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the estimation of drift, diffusion, and noise covariance from discrete observations of stochastic differential equations driven by Gaussian processes. tldr: 本文提出将神经网络与Euler近似相结合，对由加权亚分数布朗运动这类高斯过程驱动的随机微分方程进行统计推断，从离散观测数据中估计漂移系数、扩散系数与噪声协方差。
en_tdlr: This paper combines neural networks with the Euler approximation to perform inference for stochastic differential equations driven by weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion, estimating the drift, diffusion, and noise covariance from discrete observations.
